subject: bell-bodied velvet penguin

composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Build a penguin with a bell-shaped deep-blue velvet body, a pale-yellow belly panel, and short suede feet. It leans slightly forward with one small wing tucked closer than the other. Use a short matte beak and tiny stitched face details. Light the velvet from the side so its nap changes gently across the form, against pale sage fabric without snow, props, or plastic shine. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
